qa_pairs.question: What kind of job information is displayed in the "Job statistics" section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Job statistics" section displays a list of all jobs an Alliance user has started, whether they are currently running or pending. Users can view details such as the job's status (e.g., OOM, completed, running), job ID, name, start time, finish time, and allocated resources.

qa_pairs.question: How can users manage and navigate their job listings within the "Job statistics" interface?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can filter their job listings by status (such as OOM, completed, or running) from the top-left corner. They can also search for specific jobs using a job ID or job name in the top-right corner, and navigate between pages of results using multiple jumps from the bottom-right corner.
